instruction: Fix `tokenize` so it splits on whitespace and keeps multi-character numbers intact (it currently splits every character).
gold_patch:
diff --git a/rpncalc.py b/rpncalc.py
--- a/rpncalc.py
+++ b/rpncalc.py
@@ -38,7 +38,7 @@
 
 def tokenize(expr):
     """Split an RPN expression string into tokens."""
-    return list(expr.replace(" ", ""))
+    return expr.split()
